question:
Select the most appropriate of the given word.

Cursory
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cursory"** means something done quickly with minimal attention to detail; it implies superficial or hasty action. (संक्षिप्त या जल्दबाजी में किया गया)

 
 
• **Example:** He gave the document only a cursory glance before signing it.
 
 
 
• **"Brief"** refers to something concise and to the point, often short in duration or length. (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher gave a brief explanation of the topic before moving to the next lesson.
 
 
 
• Thus, the word "cursory" is most closely associated with "brief," as both imply something done quickly without much depth.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Brief**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Thorough** (गहन): Something done with great attention to detail and care.

 
 
• **Example:** The detective conducted a thorough investigation to uncover the truth.
 
 
 
• **Hasty** (जल्दबाजी में): Done with excessive speed or urgency, often leading to mistakes.
 
 
• **Example:** His hasty decision to quit his job left him in a difficult financial situation.
 
 
 
• **Superficial** (सतही): Concerned only with the surface or appearance, lacking depth or thoroughness.
 
 
• **Example:** The essay was criticized for being superficial and lacking any meaningful analysis.
